input.summary:
Pyramid NE kitchen (box 43..45 x 10..12) furnished: lit furnace stove on a stone mantle against the hearth wall (x43 z11, facing east), a one-cell spruce table at x45 z11 (fence legs, top slab) with a standing lantern on it, and barrels at x45 z10, x43 z12, x45 z12. The lane down x44 from the vestibule door to the SE bedroom door stays clear.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the room part placed 8 blocks with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. Light is 11 minimum with 0 dark floor cells, and fit reports OK for this room.
Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE only because the vestibule and front door (room-18, fittings, shell parts) are still stubs, so no room is reachable from the entrance yet.
left: Walkability cannot be confirmed until the Pyramid vestibule (room-18), the front door/porch (fittings) and the SE bedroom are built: `mcd room` reports 'no way in' for every room in the current build, and this kitchen's cells x43..44 are unreachable only for that reason. The lane x44 z10..12 and the entry x43 z10 are clear by layout.
One stove only: the plan's elements list 'four furnaces back onto the hearth mass'; this kitchen contributes one (x43 z11), and no bed is in this room (the plan gives the NE kitchen none).

plan.md ticks and elements.md checkboxes not edited: the room-level items are shared with the other pyramid rooms and the Shell A/fittings parts, and editing the shared files would race the sibling workers. The room's own elements are not ticked as complete.

waste.what: Worked the floor layout cell by cell from the plan grid: which of the 9 interior cells are the entry lane, which carry the stove, table and barrels, and that the table top must be a top slab at y4 with the lantern at y5.
waste.cost: about 9 cells of reasoning and 3 layers() calls; one retry to confirm the furnace-cell '.' trick with hearth_nook
waste.tool: A room-furnish helper in the build library: give the room box, the door cells and a list of named pieces (stove on wall X, table, barrels), and it returns the layers() rows, keeping the lane 1 wide from every door to every piece.

waste.what: Checked by hand that the lane x44 reaches both doorways and every piece, because the walk verdict is blocked by unbuilt neighbours.
waste.cost: one walk run and reading the floor grid by eye
waste.tool: `mcd room --lanes-only` or a walk that reports 'blocked by stub neighbour (room-18)' instead of a bare 'no way in', so a furnisher can tell their own layout from a missing vestibule.

waste.what: Rebuilt the whole nbt to confirm each part (about 25 s per make.sh) just to test a 3-cell furniture change.
waste.tool: A part-only dry run (build one part on a copy of the ground and shell) so a furnisher can check its own room in seconds.

companions.task: Confirm the lantern spots (table lantern at y5 plus a hanging lantern from the pyramid roof's underside) keep the room at 8+ once the vestibule and porch are lit; the table lantern alone gives 11 minimum here.
Build the four-furnace central hearth mass (x41..42 z11..14) so the stove's back and mantle sit on a finished brick face, and the chimney flue above it.
Finish the vestibule and front door at x41..42 z9..10 so the entry at x42 z10 connects to the lane, which lets the room walk-check pass.
